brief: The terminal is live. Key the number and read its verdict back.
epilogue: The green verdict remains on-screen after the receiver goes quiet.

memos.subject: RE: TERMINAL VERDICTS
memos.text: In the event of a discrepancy between the terminal and desk materials, the terminal verdict stands. The system is authoritative. Desk materials are retained for audit only.

rulebook.text: Decline any card number appearing in the current hot card bulletin.
Decline any charge that would put an account over its credit limit.
A charge at or under floor limit should not be called in. If it is, decline and note it.
Decline the second of two drafts from one merchant on one card within one shift (split draft).
Key every call into the terminal and relay its verdict.
Where terminal and desk disagree, the terminal stands.

items.head: THIRD SHIFT
items.body: Ocean Belle Fish Products advises a third shift will run through the spring season. The plant office states all positions are filled. No applications are being taken, or were required.

items.head: BIRTHS
items.body: To Mr. and Mrs. E. Grandin, a son. To Mr. and Mrs. R. Strickland, twin daughters. Congratulations.

items.head: SHIPPING NEWS
items.body: The M.V. Northern Gull maintains schedule, weather permitting. Freight for the crossing should be at the dock one hour ahead.

items.head: FISHERIES REPORT
items.body: Landings steady for the season. Prices unchanged. The plant advises the Saturday shift stands.

items.head: HOCKEY
items.body: The Mariners split the weekend, winning 4–1 at home and dropping a 5–3 decision away. Attendance was good considering the weather.

items.head: WEATHER
items.body: Fog mornings, clearing by noon most days. Wind northeast, moderate. Crossings on schedule unless noted on the wharf board.
